title: A Blink one eighty two founder from Ridgecrest
text: Mark Hoppus, bassist and singer of the rock band Blink one eighty two, was born in Ridgecrest on March 15, 1972. He left in the summer of 1992 for San Diego, to attend college and work at a local music store. That August, he and Tom DeLonge were introduced and began playing music in DeLonge's garage.
